rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken phrase for introducing or describing something taken figuratively rather than literally.

example.english: I said they could fly; I was speaking figuratively, not saying they could really fly.
example.traditional: 我講到佢飛起，係用比喻嚟講，唔係真係識飛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 dou3 keoi5 fei1 hei2 hai6 jung6 bei2 jyu6 lai4 gong2 m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 sik1 fei1
